title: CWGPT-assisted cognitive walkthrough
summary: Students evaluate the photo-upload task in a web application they authored, first unaided and then through a think-aloud cognitive walkthrough with CWGPT. They identify usability issues and discuss interface changes after reviewing the AI-guided evaluation.

sources.title: Enhancing Interface Design with AI: An Exploratory Study on a ChatGPT-4-Based Tool for Cognitive Walkthrough Inspired Evaluations
sources.evidence_quote: Each student, aged 20-25, evaluated the 'Upload a photo' task using CWGPT on their authored interface.

context.discipline: human-computer interaction and web interface design
